# @surfaces-ui/devtools

Developer tools for Surfaces UI: one component that records and shows the messages, components, problems, state, events, agent turns and service calls of agent-generated UI, with time travel.

Developer tools for agent-generated UI: one component around your app records messages, components, problems, state, events, agent turns and service calls, with time travel. On in development builds, absent in production.

## Install

```bash
npm install @surfaces-ui/devtools react react-dom
```

`react` and `react-dom` are peer dependencies: your app provides them.

## Use

```tsx
import { SurfacesDevTools } from "@surfaces-ui/devtools";

<SurfacesDevTools>
  <App />
</SurfacesDevTools>; // Ctrl+Shift+D (⌘⇧D on a Mac) opens the panel
```

## Part of Surfaces UI

Surfaces UI is a UI library for data and analytics: exploring schemas, querying, charting, tables at scale, chat, and pages an agent can build.
